dict.string: Allow saving received files to the Desktop when you choose to save there. Files are stored only with user confirmation.
Allow access to the Documents folder to let you send or save files you select. Files are accessed only with user consent.
Allow saving received files to Downloads when you choose to save there. Files are saved only with user confirmation.

Discover nearby devices on the local Wi‑Fi to enable direct file transfers. This is used only for local discovery and transfers; no location, device lists, or personal data is collected or sent to our servers.
Allow access to external drives and USBs to send or save files at your request. No data is collected or uploaded.
Allow selecting photos and videos to share with nearby devices. Media is accessed only when you choose it and is not uploaded without permission.
Allow saving received photos and videos to your photo library when you confirm.
